verdict.rationale: Entra ID documents automatic SCIM provisioning of users into SaaS and on-premises apps (Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow). It also documents Lifecycle Workflows that run automated processes across the user lifecycle phases, which plausibly covers an offboarding step. However, the evidence never states that disabling a user deprovisions their accounts downstream, never mentions session or token revocation, and never addresses timing. missing for 10: documented session/token revocation on deactivation, explicit deprovisioning on user disable, evidence of immediate (non-scheduled) propagation, a single-action leaver workflow tying these together, hands-on corroboration.
